name: alrayyes/forge-dashboard-sdk-php
description: Aggregates every repository the configured GitHub and Forgejo accounts have write access to into one read-only view: open pull requests (with CI status), open issues, and per-forge reachability. The backend holds both forges' credentials; the frontend only ever calls the endpoints below.  A request body is capped at 1 MiB, except the forges' own webhook deliveries (5 MiB). A body whose declared length is over the cap is answered `413` with an `Error` before it is read; one with no declared length is cut off at the cap and answered as an invalid body.  ## Versioning  The API's major version is in the path: every operation below lives under `/api/v1`. A breaking change (a removed or renamed field, route or status, a tighter rule) ships as `/api/v2` beside it, never in place. `info.version` is this contract's semver. Its major matches the path's, its minor grows with each compatible addition and its patch with each correction that changes no behaviour.  Three things stay outside the version because something else holds their address: `/healthz` and `/readyz` (orchestrators poll them), the forges' webhook routes under `/api/webhooks/` (each forge keeps the URL it was registered with), and `GET /api/version`, which says which major versions the running server speaks.  Until the next release the old unversioned address of each operation (`/api/dashboard`) answers `308 Permanent Redirect` to its `/api/v1` path, with a `Deprecation` header (RFC 9745). The `308` keeps the method and body, so a stale browser tab keeps working through a deploy. Move to the `/api/v1` path; the redirects are removed after one release.
